messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

I've drawn the password reset flow as a graph: the user asks for help, the web app looks up the account, emails a one-time link through the email service, and the user opens the link and sets a new password, which the app saves to Accounts.

Here is the diagram:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph backend["Your app"]
    app["Web app"]
    users[("Accounts")]
  end
  user(["User"])
  mailer{{"Email service"}}
  user ask@-->|"Forgot password"| app
  app lookup@-->|"find the account"| users
  app send_link@-->|"one-time link"| mailer
  mailer deliver@-->|"email"| user
  user open_link@-->|"opens link"| app
  app save_password@-->|"save new password"| users
```

Does this graph look right? Once you approve it, I'll ask a few questions about the story before writing the script.
The graph looks good. I approve it.
